g.text: Development final − FIFO: Map -1.208 pp; JEPA -0.915 pp; status: go. No tuning or intermediate-stage substitution.

text.style: font-size: 8.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #516574

g.text: All three primary tests retain 1 − 0.05/3 bounds from 20,000 whole-site bootstrap draws; observed and conservative pending-command bounds must both favor candidate.

text.style: font-size: 8.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #516574

g.text: Engineering gates retain worst-decile loss, maximum silence, original video and bulk margins. Source / causal / paid / exact offline integrity: True.

text.style: font-size: 8.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #516574

g.text: Fixed original JEPA ensemble is one treatment. No new fitting, matched-query RF-accuracy claim, JEPA-objective necessity, hardware qualification or SOTA claim.
